svg.text: 20 tasks · 3 benchmarks · 2 hosts × 3 setups · 1 run each
Resolved SWE-bench by its tests. QnA and DeepSearchQA only when
both judges pass (Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro).
Host $ what the host model itself uses, at API list price: the part
that comes out of your Claude or ChatGPT plan.
Total $ host + worker. Subagents bill the host's plan; agy is priced
at Gemini list price but runs on agy's own quota.
+ agy the prompt asks the host to use agy lead (/agy:lead), and lead
picks which agy job to run.
Time limit DeepSearchQA stops a trial at 30 min. 3 + agy trials hit it
(Claude Code 2, Codex 1) and count as unsolved.
Versions agy-staff 0.7.3 (f00d149), agy CLI 1.3.0 in every task
